sahneler.metin: A coal mine near Barnsley exploded.
Within hours, three hundred sixty one men and boys were dead.
Methane gas had built up in the workings.
After the first blast, rescuers went down.
Many of the dead were rescuers.
The mine had to be sealed.
It remains England's worst mining disaster.

aciklama:
Oaks explosion exploded, then exploded again during the rescue. The cause: methane explosions repeated as fires reignited gas.
